frozen_candidate_root_contribution: The root ش ب ه contributes a single thin nucleus: a GRADIENT RELATION OF LIKENESS/RESEMBLANCE holding between two or more entities (perceptual or notional), short of identity and evaluatively neutral in the root itself. The binyanim supply valence, not distinct lexical content: Form VI (تشابه / متشابه) = mutual/reciprocal resemblance; Form VIII (مشتبه) = be-resemblant (shown equivalent to VI in the same clause at 6:99); Form II (شُبِّه) = causative 'a likeness was cast/made to appear'. Confusion, deception, and interpretive ambiguity are NOT in the root: they are added compositionally by the perceiver-goal frame (عَلَى in 2:70/13:16; لِ in 4:157), by the causative binyan, or by opposition to مُحكَم (3:7).

internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across all 12 occurrences the root always means 'X is/becomes/is-made like Y' — never identity or equality. This is proven internally by the minimal pairs مُتَشَٰبِهًا / غَيْرَ مُتَشَٰبِهٍ (6:141, 6:99), where likeness is explicitly gradable and negatable, and by 6:99 pairing Form VIII (مُشْتَبِهًا) with Form VI (غَيْرَ مُتَشَٰبِهٍ) as one meaning. The famous 'confusion/ambiguity/deception' readings arise only when the surface adds a burdened observer (تشابه + عَلَى → 'became indistinguishable to them', 2:70/13:16), a causing agent (Form II شُبِّه, 4:157), or the muḥkam contrast (3:7). The account is capped below STRONG because one Form-VI lexeme carries logically incompatible senses for the same referent-domain: the WHOLE Book is praised as مُّتَشَٰبِهًا 'self-consistent' (39:23) while only SOME verses are مُتَشَٰبِهَٰت 'ambiguous', opposed to مُّحْكَمَٰت and tied to fitna (3:7). That 'ambiguous-scripture' specialization is a lexicalized sub-class not derivable from bare 'resemblance', and the causative deceptive شُبِّه (4:157) is singly attested.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: NOT identity/sameness (contrasted with غَيْرَ مُتَشَٰبِهٍ, 6:141/6:99; 2:25 provision is 'like' prior provision, not the same). NOT equality (separated from ٱسْتَوَىٰ in 13:16: هَلْ يَسْتَوِى … فَتَشَٰبَهَ). NOT external instance-comparison مثل (2:118 co-deploys both مِّثْلَ قَوْلِهِمْ then تَشَٰبَهَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ: the root is reciprocal/internal likeness within a set). NOT inherently evaluative (praise 39:23, neutral 6:141, blameworthy 3:7). NOT inherently confusion/deception (bare attributive 2:25/6:141/6:99 carry none; confusion needs عَلَى-experiencer or a causing agent). NOT itself 'ambiguous meaning' (that is the 3:7 muḥkam-opposition specialization). NOT physical-only (extends to hearts 2:118 and verse-meanings 3:7).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: The intra-lexeme collision 3:7 vs 39:23: the SAME Form VI participle مُتَشَٰبِه is predicated of the WHOLE Book as praise (self-consistent/harmonious, كِتَٰبًا مُّتَشَٰبِهًا مَّثَانِيَ, 39:23) yet of only SOME verses opposed to مُّحْكَمَٰت and tied to ٱبْتِغَآءَ ٱلْفِتْنَةِ (وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَٰبِهَٰتٌ … مَا تَشَٰبَهَ مِنْهُ, 3:7); the 'undecidable/ambiguous' sense is not derivable from 'resemblance' without importing the muḥkam contrast, and the 'consistent' vs 'ambiguous' senses are incompatible on quantity and sense and are NOT bridged Quran-internally. Secondary counterexample: 4:157 شُبِّهَ لَهُمْ, the lone Form II, a caused impersonal deceptive semblance whose 'counterfeit/substitute' force cannot be excluded at n=1.

It fits 13:16, 2:70, 3:7, 4:157 elegantly but FAILS decisively on 6:141/6:99 (species similarity the reader is COMMANDED to look at, ٱنظُرُوٓا۟, with no confusion), on 2:25 (neutral provision-likeness), and above all on 39:23 where مُتَشَٰبِه is praise of internal CONSISTENCY — the opposite of ambiguity. independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A bottom-up, B independent, C adversarial) converged on one likeness nucleus with the same two capping factors (3:7 lexicalized class; 4:157 singleton causative).
candidate_root_contribution: The root ش ب ه contributes a single thin nucleus: a GRADIENT RELATION OF LIKENESS/RESEMBLANCE holding between two or more entities (perceptual or notional), short of identity and evaluatively neutral in the root itself. The binyanim supply valence, not distinct lexical content: Form VI (تشابه / متشابه) = mutual/reciprocal resemblance; Form VIII (مشتبه) = be-resemblant (shown equivalent to VI in the same clause at 6:99); Form II (شُبِّه) = causative 'a likeness was cast/made to appear'. Confusion, deception, and interpretive ambiguity are NOT in the root: they are added compositionally by the perceiver-goal frame (عَلَى in 2:70/13:16; لِ in 4:157), by the causative binyan, or by opposition to مُحكَم (3:7).

layer_attribution.derivation: Binyan maps to valence, not lexeme: VI=mutual resemblance; VIII=be-resemblant (shown ≡VI in 6:99 within one clause); II=causative 'cast a likeness'. Morphology conditions the relational shape but does not create new senses except the lexicalized 3:7 nominal.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: A recognizable lexicalized/near-technical nominal sub-class مُتَشَٰبِه(ات) 'ambiguous verses' (3:7), opposed to مُّحْكَمَٰت — recorded as a REPRESENTATIVE-level derivational-family specialization, not promoted to the root claim.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Confusion (2:70,13:16), deception (4:157), interpretive ambiguity (3:7), and praise (39:23) are narrative/contextual outcomes supplied by frame (عَلَى/لِ), agent (Form II), or contrast (muḥkam); these must NOT become the root claim, which remains bare gradient likeness.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: 4:157 downgraded from preliminary RESISTANT to CONSISTENT (bridged causative) but retained as adversarial boundary/counterevidence; 3:7:13:1 and 3:7:21:1 upgraded from preliminary CONSISTENT to final RESISTANT on the 39:23 collision.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: The claim that مُتَشَٰبِه-of-the-Book is univocal is CONTESTED/RESISTANT: 39:23 ('consistent', whole, praised) vs 3:7 ('ambiguous', partial, cautioned) is not bridged Quran-internally and is preserved as an unresolved two-sense split within an otherwise PREFERRED likeness nucleus.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal occurrence in which ش ب ه must mean strict identity/equality (not gradient likeness), or a case where 'confusion/ambiguity/deception' is present with NO perceiver-goal (عَلَى/لِ), no causing binyan, and no muḥkam-style contrast — showing the epistemic force is root-borne rather than compositional.
rejection_condition.search_location: All 12 packet occurrences, especially the عَلَى-frame verbs (2:70, 13:16), the Form II 4:157, and the bare attributive tokens (2:25, 6:141, 6:99, 39:23) that currently carry no confusion.
rejection_condition.verification_method: For each token check whether removing the perceiver-goal/causer/muḥkam-contrast eliminates the epistemic reading; check the negatability of the likeness via غَيْرَ مُتَشَٰبِهٍ and its separation from ٱسْتَوَىٰ (13:16) and مثل (2:118).
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Do not let the crucifixion narrative (4:157) or the fitna motive (3:7) be read back into the root; hold morphology fixed (VI vs VIII shown equivalent at 6:99) so binyan-supplied valence is not mistaken for lexical content.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If root-borne identity/equality or non-compositional confusion were found, the 'gradient valence-neutral likeness' nucleus would be rejected and the root reclassified (toward an 'ambiguity/confusion' core or a genuine multi-root split).

reopen_conditions: If a Quran-internal bridge is later demonstrated between 39:23 (مُتَشَٰبِه = whole-Book self-consistency, praised) and 3:7 (مُتَشَٰبِهَٰت = some verses, ambiguous, opposed to مُّحْكَمَٰت), the lexicalized_ambiguous_scripture cluster should be re-dispositioned toward CONSISTENT and the grade reconsidered upward.

If additional Form II (شُبِّه-type causative) occurrences beyond 4:157 appear or are admitted, re-test whether the causative carries a distinct lexicalized 'counterfeit/substitute' sense versus plain causative-of-likeness, which currently caps strength.

If any عَلَى-experiencer or لِ-dative token (2:70, 13:16, 4:157) is shown to retain 'confusion/deception' after the perceiver-goal is removed, reopen to test whether the epistemic force is root-borne rather than compositional.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The likeness nucleus survives adversarial pressure on 10/12 tokens and is distinctive (separated from ٱسْتَوَىٰ, مثل, and its own antonym غَيْرَ مُتَشَٰبِهٍ), but the 3:7 lexicalized 'ambiguous-scripture' sub-class resists reduction and collides with 39:23; per contract, with the core holding but some occurrences resisting, falsification is NOT_RUN and the resisters are recorded rather than declaring PASSED or FAILED.
